description: Unit tests for BoringSSL's CAST cipher implementation, testing ECB and CBC modes with predefined test vectors.

classes.name: CastTestCase
classes.description: Structure holding test vectors for CAST cipher tests, including key, plaintext, IV, and expected ciphertexts for ECB and CBC modes.

methods.name: TEST(CAST, ECB)
methods.description: Performs ECB mode encryption/decryption tests on predefined vectors, verifying correctness against expected ciphertexts.

methods.name: TEST(CAST, CBC)
methods.description: Performs CBC mode encryption/decryption tests on predefined vectors, verifying correctness against expected ciphertexts.
